About Me

Hello, I'm
Samba Sowe

I am a Multimedia Expert with over five years of experience in creative design, digital media, branding, music consultancy, marketing, and content creation.

Through BeGlitch, I transform ideas into impactful visual concepts — from brand identities and album covers to event flyers, book designs, and full social media campaigns.

I've worked with businesses, music artists, academies, and fashion brands across The Gambia and beyond.
